title: San Jamar Escali Promzr M-Series Digital Scale with Display Hold for Kitchens and Restaurants, Metal, 33 Pound, Silver
description:
About this item
Convenient Taring: Quickly reset the scale to zero weight, allowing you to measure multiple items in a single container with ease, streamlining your food preparation
Battery Operated: This versatile scale can be powered by 4 C batteries (included) for portability or with a 9V adapter (sold separately), making it ideal for various light and medium-duty kitchen tasks
Easy to Clean: The metal frame and sealed buttons are designed for easy cleaning, easily wiped clean with a damp cloth. Additionally, the stainless-steel measuring plate is removable for convenient and thorough cleanup
Low Profile Design: With an overall height of just 4.75 inches, this scale is perfect for use in kitchens with limited space, allowing it to fit under cabinets or in other confined areas, providing flexibility in your workspace
reviews_5s:
I am an institutional cook. I batch cook for 100 to 600 meals over a 3 hour period. Portion control is critical and with this scales large platform and the ability to weigh up to 66 pounds I can easily hit my metrics. I use it for weekly inventory as it is either plug in or battery. The stainless steel removable top is easy to sanitize. The 66# limit and tare feature allows me to weigh right in my hotel pans. It has a footprint of about 12x12 in. And while sturdily built still light weight. I like it so much I use the same one at home. Grams, ounce, ounce and pound or just pounds the mode feature puts you in control I'm sure you'll love it as much as I do.Bought 2 of these to use in our bakery and they hold up very well. Accurate and strong.Great scale for price. Have used it many times without any issues.These are the most reliable, best scales to use in restaurants. You can weigh in multiple different ways. Always order San Jamar, just the bestMy loaves are 900 g-1200 g and this is the perfect size to use for dividing in the cottage house/microbakery setting. I used a pan on top of a cheap Walmart scale, so you can imagine how fun that was trying to keep it from moving.

Only downside is it doesn't stay on for long. And the cord doesn't usually come with it. It's optional.Got this for my son who owns a food truck. It makes portion control much easier. It's restaurant quality and very sturdy. I'm happy with my purchase.I build large batches of dough, and place my 25 pound stand mixer bowl right on it. Add my ingredients up to the 66 pound limit and it works. When I portion my dough, it is accurate to within 2 grams. So you get the size you want and the accuracy you need all in one scale.My husband wanted a scale for his pizza dough but he is very picky...I purchased this one because it had high reviews and it does not disappoint! It is perfect for weighing, plug in or battery operated. Lightweight but durable, does not take up alot of space in our small kitchen.Excelente productoWe like this scale so much we bought a second one. We sell live crawfish and this scale accurately weighs our 35 lb sacks.
reviews_1s: Purchased this item in March and by September the AC connection point failed making the scale only usable with batteries. The double unfortunate about this is that when using the scale with batteries it will auto shut off after a relatively short amount of time forcing one to have to re-tare if you are mid weighing. I had a prior version of this scale that I used for 10 years before the AC connector point failed just like this one. Thought I'd get more than 6 months out of the new one though.Never calibrated correctly and cant find out how to calibrate.
